notes: OAK-D Lite optical center is physically measured 0.21 m above the floor. camera_pitch_deg is the angle between the camera axis and THE FLOOR IT IS REJECTING, so it absorbs both mount tolerance and local floor slope -- re-run src/floor_plane_validate.py after any move, including a translation on the same floor. Measured 2026-09-04 at the apartment test marker: Theil-Sen fit of p16 floor height vs range over 7 clean bins (z-max 4.0 m) gave +1.077 deg nose-down, confirmed by a re-run whose residual was -0.058 deg (slope -0.0010 m/m, RMS 0.0026 m), and independently by the OAK BMI270 gravity vector at +1.032 deg -- agreement to 0.046 deg. This matches the lab's +1.157 deg, so ~1.1 deg is the real mount tolerance. A spot 1.5 m behind the marker gave +0.346 deg with geometry and IMU disagreeing by 0.6 deg, which was a local floor anomaly at that spot, not a change in chassis attitude. Measured roll is -1.95 deg and is NOT modelled by the single-pitch height equation.
